story.title: Fort Worth firefighters battle 27 fires in just over 24 hours
story.summary: Firefighters responded to 27 fires in just over 24 hours as families prepare to cook, gather and heat their homes for Thanksgiving Fort Worth firefighters battled 27 fires across the city in just over 24 hours this week, an unusually busy stretch that displaced eight people and prompted the department to remind families about fire safety as they gather for Thanksgiving. No one was killed or injured in the fires, Fort Worth Fire Deputy Chief Ralph Diamond said. However, some families suffered significant losses, including one that lost two pets. “Now twenty-seven fires in twenty-four hours, that's significant even for the holidays,” Diamond said. Investigators are still determining the causes of the fires.
